overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet on September 17, 2026, to conduct routine business including a closed session for interviewing Village Clerk candidates. The meeting was set to address personnel matters and consider items for future agenda discussion.

agenda.item: Call Meeting to Order - Pledge of Allegiance and Roll Call
Closed Session - Interviewing Village Clerk Candidates
Consideration of Items for Future Agenda

discussions.item: Closed Session - Interviewing Village Clerk Candidates
discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene into closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(c) for consideration of employment and personnel matters related to Village Clerk candidates. The closed session was set to allow for confidential interviews and discussion of employment-related data without public attendance.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a 15-minute total time limit and three minutes per person, with possible time extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion. No action was scheduled to be taken on public comments received.
